scope: Original 67 file paths. Shared icon sizes and exact photo copies are exports of the same new master, not unrelated designs. Source masters are additional reproducibility files.
limitations: 12 screen files are labelled generated design previews; require actual native recapture and acceptance before App Store submission.
8 SVGs embed new PNG sources; raster-backed, not native vector artwork.
Corrupted.jpg intentionally fails decoding; accepted only as a negative fixture.
Native icon/UI light/dark rendering, accessibility and StoreKit acceptance remain pending Apple validation.
corrections: Rejected noisy first transparent mark; regenerated clean colored and mono marks.
Removed inconsistent generated logo symbols from all desktop previews; use Keptora text wordmark.
Removed nonexistent object/background retouching from desktop history and unsupported easy recovery claims.
Narrowed desktop privacy copy to on-device photo analysis; removed Pro crown and handwritten ornaments.
Corrected desktop duplicates counter to 2 groups / 6 photos.
Fixed macOS icon export composition; reopened every affected PNG and SVG.
